description: This file manages plugin commands in a software project, including registration, matching, sanitization, execution, and listing of plugin commands. It interacts with conversation bindings, command registry state, and external modules for command handling.

methods.name: matchPluginCommand
methods.description: Matches a command body string to a registered plugin command, returning the command and arguments if matched.

methods.name: sanitizeArgs
methods.description: Sanitizes command arguments to prevent injection, enforcing length limits and removing control characters.

methods.name: resolveBindingConversationFromCommand
methods.description: Resolves conversation binding context based on command parameters and active plugin channel registry.

methods.name: executePluginCommand
methods.description: Executes a plugin command handler with sanitized arguments, handling authorization, conversation binding, and error management.

methods.name: listPluginCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered plugin commands with their name, description, and plugin ID.
